title: Typed read-only session statistics

implementation.port: Existing AgentRuntimeDirectory / AgentRuntimeRegistry committed read port; Operation::Statistics uses Access::Read without native session restoration, writer ownership or Timeline writes.
implementation.consumer: DaemonClient.getAgentStatistics -> apps/mobile/src/components/usage/session-statistics.tsx -> existing context-window-details/context-window-meter entry, available even without context facts.
implementation.semantics: Explicit nullable metrics; known zero preserved. provider_snapshot is the latest provider report, not a guaranteed session aggregate or last-turn delta. Configured and runtime-confirmed models remain separate. Account quotas and child usage are separately labelled existing resources. No estimated costs, snapshot summation or duplicate accounting state.
implementation.source_correction: OMP add_usage preserves unknown cumulative cache/cost when any native message omits the field, instead of fabricating cache zero or presenting partial cost as a complete total. Native known zero remains zero. No other OMP transport changes.
implementation.compatibility: Negotiated agentStatisticsGet capability; old hosts receive no unsupported RPC. Existing connection generation/epoch and Query cancellation isolate late replies. No new Timeline/message variants; old clients retain existing messages.
implementation.inventory: Full source inventory remains in Draft #647; this record does not copy the task00 plan. Donor was read as reference only, not cherry-picked.

acceptance: Unknown metric is null/unavailable, not zero or a guessed price; actual zero remains zero.
Repeated provider snapshots replace rather than sum; no unsupported session/run aggregate is claimed.
Current selected session, configured/confirmed models, account quotas and child usage stay distinct.
Typed SDK/protocol and actual application UI show matching values; old-host downgrade sends no query.
Runtime reads during an active native turn add no input/writer or interruption and leave the turn running.
No native /stats dashboard, /status console, arbitrary native_action gateway or new Todo/Goal/child editors.
